# `Q-16-13` — Extension Is Now Built In

> A `filters` entry names an extension whose feature is now part of
> Quarto, so the entry is ignored.

## What this means

Some features started out as extensions in the `quarto-ext` organization
and were later built into Quarto, such as
[`quarto-ext/lightbox`](../../guides/formats/html/lightbox.qmd). A
document that still lists such an extension under `filters` would run it
on top of the built-in feature, so Quarto ignores the entry and uses the
built-in feature instead.

## How to fix

Remove the entry from `filters` and delete the extension's folder,
`_extensions/quarto-ext/<name>/`. Any options the extension read, such as
`lightbox:`, keep working with the built-in feature.
